description: Get the trending topics of any country or city on X (Twitter). No login or cookies needed.

allLocations.description: Collect trends for every location X serves (currently 467 countries and cities, up to 50 trends each). When enabled, the Locations list is ignored. Tip: you can also put "all" in the Locations list.
allLocations.title: All available locations

includeSearchUrls.description: Include a ready-made X search link for every trend.
includeSearchUrls.title: Include search links

includeTweetVolume.description: Include the approximate number of posts using each trend when X publishes it. X often omits it, so the field is present only when available.
includeTweetVolume.title: Include approximate post volume

locations.description: Countries or cities to get trends for. Examples: Worldwide, United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, India, Pakistan, Japan, South Korea, Germany, France, Brazil, London, New York, Tokyo, Paris, Dubai, Karachi, Sydney. You can also paste a numeric WOEID such as 23424977.
locations.title: Locations

maxTrendsPerLocation.description: How many ranked trends to keep for each location. X publishes up to 50.
maxTrendsPerLocation.title: Maximum trends per location

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use a proxy if you plan large or repeated runs.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional settings for large or repeated runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

title: Twitter (X) Trends Scraper
